title: Body Scan
description: A slow sweep of attention from the crown of the head to the toes.

segments.say: Find a comfortable position, either sitting or lying down.
Let your eyes close, softly.
There is nothing to do here but notice.
Begin by taking one slow breath in through the nose.
And letting it go.
Let your breathing settle into its own rhythm.
Now bring your attention to the top of your head.
Notice any sensation there. Warmth. Tingling. Or nothing at all.
Let your attention move down to your forehead, and the space between your eyebrows.
If you find tension there, let it soften.
Move down to your jaw.
Let your teeth part slightly. Let the jaw hang loose.
Now your neck, and your throat.
Let your shoulders drop away from your ears.
Feel the weight of your arms.
All the way down, through the elbows, into the hands.
Notice your fingertips.
Bring your attention to your chest.
Feel it rise, and fall, without changing anything.
Let your attention settle into your belly.
Soften there.
Now your back. The whole length of your spine.
Notice where your body meets the surface beneath you.
Let it hold you.
Move your attention into your hips.
Down through your thighs.
Your knees.
Your calves.
Down into your ankles, and your feet.
Notice your toes.
Now let your attention widen, to include the whole body at once.
Resting here. Breathing.
Nothing to fix. Nothing to reach for.
Stay with this.
In a moment, we will finish.
Begin to notice the sounds around you.
Let your breath deepen a little.
And when you are ready, let your eyes open.
